changes: Book Boxes & Special Editions — use My Book Boxes for recurring subscriptions and Special Editions & Box Books for individual collector copies; track deliveries, price, condition, signed copies, extras, notes, and yearly spending in one place.
Book Boxes lists — My Book Boxes and Special Editions & Box Books include compact, cover-aware lists with search, filters, and sorting for a growing collection.
Book Boxes details on Book Detail — link a saved entry to a Library book and see its edition and purchase details in one place.
Special Editions Library view — use the new monochrome ✦ view between Shelves and Owned to see every collector-linked book together.

Duplicate Book — create another edition from Book Detail without retyping shared metadata; reading progress, ratings, dates, notes, cover, and other entry-specific details are cleared for the new copy.
Upcoming Releases — manually plan anticipated titles with calendar covers, year controls, links, list management, and a release-day handoff into Want to Read.
Budget — review book purchases, Book Box charges, active subscriptions, and annual spending breakdowns in your selected default currency.
Borrowed Books — record loans, lenders, due dates, return status, optional covers, and only the fees you choose to enter; pick an existing Library book when available.
Reading Calendar — see cover-based reading history, log first reads and re-reads from a day, edit or clear individual intervals, browse by year, and optionally show finished-book ratings.
Feature Toggles — hide any optional page you do not use, including Book Memory, Journal, Quotes, Re-Read Radar, Challenges, Book Boxes, Upcoming Releases, Budget, and Borrowed Books.

More inclusive and flexible book entry — searchable Narrators, Translator and nonfiction-friendly POV fields, audiobook-aware length and DNF tracking, and an expanded built-in tag pack for LGBTQIA+, BIPOC/POC, Own Voices, activism, and related themes.
Bingo starter packs — begin a Bingo challenge from editable examples with labelled inspiration links and square, readable prompt cells.

Smarter tag autocomplete — tags stay consistent across Bulk Edit, Book Detail, and Edit Book. Arrow keys navigate suggestions, while Enter saves the exact text you typed unless you deliberately select a suggestion; this works for genres, tags, tropes, and content warnings.
Faster book entry — Author suggestions reuse names already in your library, and custom Source and Discovery options can be saved and reused from Add Book or Edit Book.
Better library tools — full Cards-view covers, page-length filters and sorting, correct reading-status labels, direct shelf opening, and collector-aware duplicate review.
Better DNF and detail tracking — record Date Stopped and Pages Read with automatic DNF percentage, save Spice Ratings in Book Detail, and return newly added books to their detail page.
Challenge improvements — type goals directly, edit template challenge titles, choose or clear proof books, and use challenge suggestions that respect relevant prompt rules.
Book Detail quick actions — see an Owned label beside the book’s key status details and change reading status directly from Book Detail; Library now keeps the current view name visible.
Nonfiction-friendly Book Memory — choose Fiction, Nonfiction, or automatic prompt matching in Add/Edit Book; nonfiction prompts focus on ideas, people, evidence, context, and takeaways.
Add a Series — create several books at once with shared author, series, genres, and starting status, while keeping each title, number, and optional cover URL separate and editable.

Challenge Planner — reserve Library books for a challenge before reading, label the prompt they are intended to fulfill, reorder your planned books, and organize challenges with groups and manual order.
Reading Journal dashboard — see total posts, unique books journaled, entry types, and latest activity at the top of the Journal page.
Start Here guide — a new Help topic introduces Home customization, Library views, settings and Feature Toggles, TBR Randomizer, Book Boxes, and backups.
Book format multi-select — a book can now be marked as Physical, eBook, Audiobook, or any combination; select multiple formats as chips in Add/Edit Book
Editable challenges — challenges can now be edited after creation; click the Edit button on any challenge detail view

Task-based challenge type — new Pick One challenge type where each item has a rich description and three reading tasks; complete any one task to mark the item done (great for themed challenges like album or artist reading lists)
Image upload in Quotes — add an optional screenshot or image to any quote or highlight alongside the text; paste from clipboard, drag and drop, or click to browse
Custom content warnings — type your own content warning tags in Add/Edit Book; tags are saved and suggested as a dropdown next time

Home dashboard modules are now clickable — Books Read filters the library to read books, Currently Reading filters to in-progress books, Rating sorts by highest rating, Series navigates to series view, Favorites navigates to favorites view

Fixed: Library no longer resets to page 1 after editing a book and returning
Fixed: Duplicate book detection now shows consistent results on every scan
Fixed: Search bar in the library is now always clickable and typeable
Reading Challenges — set goals like reading 50 books, completing a genre bingo card, reading books by title alphabet, or a decade challenge; 11 built-in templates and fully custom challenge creation
Bingo challenges — 3×3, 4×4, or 5×5 bingo cards with optional free centre square; BINGO line and full blackout detection
Share your challenge progress — export a beautifully designed PNG card to share anywhere
Active Challenges widget on the Home dashboard — pin up to 3 challenges to keep track at a glance
Add to Challenge button on every Book Detail page — mark a book as proof for any active challenge
TBR Randomizer filters — filter your Want to Read list by genre and format before spinning the randomiser
Publication date field — record year, month, and day of publication in Add/Edit Book
Shelf assignment from Book Detail — add or remove a book from any shelf directly from its detail page
Shelf assignment in Add/Edit Book — assign shelves while adding or editing a book

Owned bookmark toggle now appears on every library view — Cards, Table, Bookshelf, Series, Authors, Shelves, Owned, and Favourites
New dedicated Owned view and Favourites view in the library toolbar
Bulk edit — select multiple books and update status, rating, genre, tags, or delete in one action
Library scroll position is now preserved after editing a book — returns to exactly where you left off
Word count field added alongside page count — especially useful for ebooks (e.g. via Calibre)
Multiple re-read dates — record start date, finish date, and notes for every time you re-read a book
Drag-and-drop cover upload — drag an image from your computer or spreadsheet, or paste from clipboard (Ctrl+V)
Spine color reset button — restores the auto-extracted dominant cover color if you have changed it manually
Series completion — series auto-marks as Complete when all books are read, with manual override; filter by Ongoing First or Ongoing Only
Memory Check now scores against your own book notes — no internet connection required; the more detail you add, the richer the quiz
View Last Results button on Book Memory — review your most recent quiz without starting a new session
Search now ignores leading articles — searching 'Persian' finds 'The Persian'
Sort direction toggle — switch between ascending and descending order with the ↑/↓ button in all library views

Quote of the Day widget on the Home dashboard is now draggable, resizable, and hideable like all other widgets
Manage Genres — add, edit, or remove genres from the app-wide list; custom genres appear in Add Book, Edit Book, Bulk Edit, and the library genre filter
Goodreads import now recognises custom status shelves (paused, abandoned, dnf, on-hold, abandoned-forever, etc.) and maps them to the correct reading status automatically
Goodreads import no longer adds status shelves as genres or tags
Goodreads import validates dates — finish dates are removed from non-completed books, and impossible dates (finish before added) are corrected gracefully
CSV import now reads the status column — previously ignored
CSV import supports cover_url column — paste a direct image URL to skip the automatic cover search
CSV import cover search now uses Open Library first (no rate limit) before falling back to Google Books — significantly improves cover success rate on large imports
Duplicate book finder now uses fuzzy matching — ignores leading articles (The/A/An) and punctuation, and also detects duplicates by ISBN
Storage usage display in Settings → Advanced — see how much space your library is using and free up space by removing embedded cover images
Storage limit removed on desktop — Readwisp no longer hits the 100 MB localStorage cap on Windows and Mac
Tags filter tooltip explains why the filter is greyed out when no tags exist yet
Mac window drag — the app window can now be dragged from the sidebar header area on macOS
Update notifications — a banner appears when a new version is available; Windows and Mac users each get a direct link to the correct installer
Changelog — click the version number in Settings to see what changed in each version
Drag-to-reorder your library — switch to Sort: Manual Order in Cards, Table, or Bookshelf view
Custom shelves — create named shelves like 'Favourites', 'Summer Reads', 'Lent Out'
Find and remove duplicate books — Settings → Library & Data → Scan for Duplicates
Dominant Cover Color spine style — spines take on each book's most prominent cover colour
Add books to a series from the Series view without opening each book individually
Customisable dashboard layout — drag and resize every widget on the Home dashboard
Barcode scanner support — scan any book's ISBN barcode to auto-fill title, author, and cover
Six reading statuses — added Paused and Re-reading alongside existing statuses
Memory checks for every book you've started (not just finished books)
Tag and Audience Age filters — filter by Tag, Audience Age, Status, and Genre combined
Favourite from any view — heart icon on cards, table rows, and bookshelf spines
Favourites First sort option
Narrator field for audiobooks
Tags on journal entries
Genre is now a structured dropdown field
Edit entry date in the reading journal after saving
Date Started/Finished now correctly handled after Goodreads import
